label: Tool Management
title: Tool Management
subtitle: The single surface for tools: create and delete custom tools from a plain definition, move them between global and project scope, browse them, inspect one to clone it, and register an already-running external MCP server to discover its tools.
whenToUse: Used when an agent needs to build a new capability on the fly (create a custom tool), confine a tool to a single project (or promote it to every project), or change which tools an agent can use — for example, temporarily giving an agent the Shell tool for one phase, then removing it.

methods.name: Create Tool
methods.description: Creates a custom tool from a plain definition of methods and handler code.

methods.name: List Tools
methods.description: Browses the registered tools — id, description, methods, origin.

methods.name: Inspect Tool
methods.description: Copies a tool's package into the project folder so its source can be read and cloned.

methods.name: Change Tool Scope
methods.description: Moves a custom tool between global and project scope.

methods.name: Discover MCP Server
methods.description: Registers an already-running external MCP server by URL and discovers its tools.
